All modules

today

pages · 0.8.0 · aj-p-today

Today: the day's record as it is written (entries, recordings, the product's notes), its mood and the writing companion at its foot (the composer with the recent overview). One render for every platform; desktop puts the masthead and the destinations in the title block beside the page.
